distance.caution: 1/parallax is biased as the error grows, which is why the cut is 10%

catalogue.query: SELECT hip_number, ra, dec, parallax, parallax_error, hip_mag, bv_color FROM hipnewcat WHERE parallax > 0 AND parallax_error < 0.1 * parallax

selection.rule: parallax > 0 and its formal error < 10% of it

catalogue.title: Hipparcos, the New Reduction (van Leeuwen 2007)
